lineage: Linked to DarkSide/BlackMatter operators; FBI disruption Dec 2023; apparent exit scam after Change Healthcare (Mar 2024)
summary: Rust-based RaaS (first major Rust ransomware) with Windows, Linux and ESXi lockers. Affiliates included Scattered Spider/Octo Tempest, who used help-desk social engineering, plus others exploiting Veritas Backup Exec and Exchange. Post-access: RMM tools, ngrok/Ligolo tunnels, ADRecon, Mimikatz/LaZagne, signed malicious kernel drivers to kill EDR, ExMatter/rclone exfiltration, and an encryptor with embedded PsExec propagation.
uniqueTraits: Rust encryptor with JSON config, embedded PsExec self-propagation and remote/local symlink enabling
Help-desk vishing and MFA reset via Scattered Spider/Octo Tempest affiliates
Signed malicious kernel driver (BYOVD-style) to terminate EDR
Veritas Backup Exec CVE-2021-27876/27877/27878 initial access (UNC4466)
Full event-log clearing loop via wevtutil

chain.procedure: Scattered Spider/Octo Tempest affiliates call the IT help desk or employees posing as staff/IT to reset passwords and MFA, or SIM-swap, to gain SSO access.
chain.noAtomicReason: Voice social engineering of the help desk is a human process; no endpoint atomic reproduces it. Validate via IdP MFA-reset and help-desk audit logs.

chain.procedure: UNC4466 exploited Veritas Backup Exec CVE-2021-27876/27877/27878 via the public Metasploit module; other affiliates used unpatched Exchange and stolen VPN credentials.
chain.noAtomicReason: Local catalogue has no T1190 exploit atomic (and plans never add exploit code); validate with perimeter/WAF/appliance log detections instead.
